Title: General availability: Linux on App Service Environment

Body.Content:
Linux on App Service Environment is generally available. It combines the features from App Service on Linux and App Service Environment.

As we announced in the public preview, Linux customers will be able to take advantage of deploying Linux and containerized apps in an App Service Environment, which is ideal for deploying applications into a virtual network for secure network access or apps running at a high scale.

In addition to this announcement, we're recapping the deployment of our Linux offerings into currently 26 available regions.

For full details on this announcement and support, see the team blog.
